buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall carefully read and understand all technical specifications, Additional Terms & Condition s (ATC) and other requirements mentioned in the bid before submission of the offer. 2. The bidder shall quote for a Commercial-Grade, Vertical, Four-Door Stainless Steel Chiller conforming to the specifications mentioned. 3. The offered product must be new, unused, genuine and of current manufacturing, and shall not be refur bished, reconditioned or second-hand. 4. The bidder shall ensure that the quoted product meets all the stipulated technical parameters. Any devi ation shall be clearly highlighted in the technical bid. 5. The following documents shall be uploaded along with the technical bid:- 5.1 Copy of GST Registration Certificate. 5.2 Copy of PAN Card of the firm/company. 5.3 Valid undertaking regarding acceptance of all terms and conditions of the bid.

5.4 Manufacturer's Authorisation Certificate (MAF), wherever the bidder is not the Original Equipment Ma nufacturer (OEM). 5.5 Technical catalogue/brochure of the offered product clearly indicating make, model and technical spe cifications. 5.6 Point-wise compliance statement against all technical specifications mentioned. 5.7 Undertaking confirming that the offered equipment is brand new and unused. 5.8 Warranty undertaking confirming minimum three years comprehensive warranty, including compres sor. 5.9 Details of authorised service centre/customer support facility and contact details for after-sales serv ice. 5.10 Undertaking regarding availability of spare parts and after-sales support during the warranty perio d. 5.11 Bank account details of the firm, duly supported by relevant documentary evidence, wherever req uired. 5.12 Any other document specifically required under the GeM bid conditions. 6. The TEC shall have the authority to recommend acceptance or rejection of a bidder based on objective a ssessment of the documents submitted and compliance with the stipulated eligibility criteria and technical specifications. 7. A bidder may be declared technically non-responsive/rejected on any of the following grounds:- 7.1 Failure to submit mandatory documents specified in the ATC, even after seeking clarification where ver permissible. 7.2 Non-submission of valid GST registration or PAN details, wherever applicable. 7.3 Failure to submit a valid Manufacturer's Authorisation Certificate, wherever applicable. 7.4 Non-submission of technical brochure/catalogue or supporting documents necessary to establish com pliance with the specifications.

7.5 Offered product not meeting the minimum technical specifications. 7.6 Offering refurbished, used, reconditioned or second-hand equipment. 7.7 Failure to confirm the stipulated three years comprehensive warranty, including compressor. 7.8 Submission of false, forged, misleading or materially incorrect documents/information. 7.9 Any material deviation from the stipulated ATC or technical requirements. 7.10 Failure to furnish satisfactory clarification or supporting documents when specifically sought by the TEC within the stipulated time. 7.11 The TEC may seek clarification or additional supporting documents from bidders wherever co nsidered necessary, provided such clarification does not permit alteration of the original offer, price or material technical specifications. 8. The purchaser reserves the right to seek a product demonstration, technical clarification or inspection of the offered model wherever considered necessary for verification of technical compliance. 9. If a sample or demonstration is specifically stipulated in the GeM bid, the bidder shall arrange the same at its own cost within the prescribed time. 10. Failure to provide the stipulated sample or demonstration, without a valid reason, may render the bidd er technically non-responsive. 11. The physical inspection or demonstration shall be carried out uniformly and objectively for the concern ed bidders wherever applicable. 12. The supplied chiller shall carry a minimum three years comprehensive warranty from the date of succe ssful installation and acceptance. 13. Warranty shall cover the complete equipment, including compressor, electrical components, cooling sy stem and other integral parts. 14. Any defect arising during the warranty period shall be rectified or defective components replaced by th e supplier without any additional financial liability to the purchaser. .
